## About
Complete Automotive Systems is a family-owned and operated shop on National Blvd, serving West Los Angeles. We work on foreign and domestic cars, with an emphasis on European makes like Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Audi and Land Rover. We're Bosch certified, an ASE Blue Station, AAA approved and a STAR smog station.
John Abdelmalak is our general manager, and he likes to check in on the progress himself. Javier and the techs handle the diagnosis, and one customer with an older BMW says they've sorted out problems that border on the bizarre or rare.
We'll tell you what's wrong, walk you through your options and let you decide. One customer says he, his wife and his grown kids won't take their cars anywhere else, and we'd like to earn that from you too.

## Services
- European automotive repair services: Our specialty. Routine Audi maintenance, in-depth Mercedes work, and service for BMW, Porsche, Land Rover, Jaguar, MINI, Volkswagen and Bentley.
- Engine tune-ups: Keep the car you've had for years running the way it should.
- Automatic and manual transmission maintenance: Transmission service for both automatics and manuals.
- Full-service oil changes: Conventional, synthetic blend and full synthetic.
- Tire balancing, wheel alignment, and other tire services: From a quick tire rotation to balancing and alignment.
- Cooling system services: Along with fuel injection system cleaning and power steering work.
- Hybrid repair services: Repair and service for hybrid vehicles.
- STAR smog station: A reviewer's truck came in not running, and we fixed it and were able to smog it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on European cars?
A: European cars are our specialty, but our team has the knowledge and parts to handle domestic, Japanese and electric vehicles too.

Q: Can I get an estimate without coming in?
A: Yes. Fill in the form on our site and we'll send you a quick estimate by email.

Q: Will you try to sell me work I don't need?
A: No. We'll explain what's wrong and help you understand your options so you can make an informed decision.

Q: How long will you have my car?
A: It depends on the job. A longtime customer says it's usually a one day affair, sometimes overnight if we're waiting on parts.
